name: Attachment
description: A file attached to a message, task or form: its icon, name and detail, with a download link, other actions, and a remove button before sending.
whenToUse: To show a file on a message, comment or task, e.g. "Guidelines.pdf · 2.4 MB".
In a composer, to show files that are about to be sent and can be removed.

whenNotToUse.text: For uploading files; it does not pick them.
For a list of many files with columns.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.description: A tile showing the file type.

anatomy.name: Name
anatomy.description: The file name; a download link when href is set.

anatomy.name: Detail
anatomy.description: Size or source, e.g. "2.4 MB" or "Google Drive".

anatomy.name: Remove
anatomy.description: Removes the file before it is sent.

states.name: Hover
states.meaning: The name is underlined when it is a link.

states.name: Focus
states.meaning: Shows keyboard focus on the link or a control.

behavior.text: With href the name downloads the file; the browser decides where it goes.
onRemove is called when the close button is pressed; remove the item in your handler.
Long names are cut with an ellipsis; the full name stays in the link.

content: Show the file name as it is saved, e.g. "Q3-report.pdf".
Show size or source as detail, e.g. "2.4 MB" or "Google Drive".

guidelines.do: Use a remove button only before a message is sent.
guidelines.dont: Let people remove files from a message that was already sent.
guidelines.why: Sent attachments are part of the record other people have seen.

guidelines.do: Show the file type with the icon.
guidelines.dont: Use the same generic icon for every file.
guidelines.why: Icons help people spot the file they need.

guidelines.do: Make the name a download link when the file can be downloaded.
guidelines.dont: Make the name look like a link when it only opens a menu.
guidelines.why: A link should do what it looks like it does.

accessibility.role: group of content with a link or text for the name.

keyboard.action: Moves to the name link and then the actions and remove button.
Downloads the file from the link.

aria.when: On the remove button, from removeLabel or "Remove {name}".

accessibility.focus: The link and each button show a focus ring.

wcag.how: The link text is the file name, which says where it goes.
Link, actions and remove are all keyboard reachable.
Name and detail pass AA on every background in every theme.

notes: The file icon is decorative; the name carries the meaning.

examples.title: Downloadable file
examples.description: A file with a link and its size.
examples.code:
import { Attachment } from '@ds/react';

<Attachment name="Guidelines.pdf" detail="2.4 MB" href="/files/guidelines.pdf" />

examples.title: In a composer
examples.description: A small file that can be removed before sending.
examples.code:
import { Attachment } from '@ds/react';

<Attachment size="small" name="Q3-report.xlsx" detail="180 KB" onRemove={() => remove(file.id)} />

examples.title: From another app
examples.description: The detail names where the file lives.

related.relation: For a plain list of files.

components.name: Attachment
components.description: A file attached to a message, a task or a form: its icon, name, detail and actions.

detail.description: Size or source shown under the name, e.g. "2.4 MB" or "Google Drive".

icon.description: Icon for the file type. Default a generic file icon.

href.description: Makes the name a download link to this URL.

actions.description: Other controls at the end, e.g. a preview button.

onRemove.description: Shows a remove button; called when it is pressed (e.g. before sending).

removeLabel.description: Words for the remove button. Default "Remove {name}".

size.description: `small` in composers and chat, `medium` (default) in forms and lists.

--attachment-gap.description: Gap between related items in a group.

--attachment-padding.description: Gap between related items in a group.

--attachment-small-padding.description: Tightest gap between tightly related items, e.g. icon and label.

--attachment-border-radius.description: Controls and small surfaces: inputs, buttons, menu items.

--attachment-font-family.description: Body text and most UI text.

--attachment-detail-color.description: Supporting text on surfaces: descriptions, metadata, placeholders.

--attachment-actions-gap.description: Hairline gap (2px), e.g. between rating stars.

--attachment-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring.

--attachment-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between an element and its focus ring.

--attachment-focus-ring-color.description: Focus ring color; follows the brand accent.
